exitGates.gate: A user can be invited, authenticated, authorized, suspended, and audited securely.
notes: Tokens are stored as SHA-256 digests; passwords use scrypt; TOTP seeds are AES-256-GCM encrypted.
Login throttling, password recovery, TOTP MFA with recovery codes, and admin MFA reset are covered.
The `privileged` MFA policy (the production default) was checked manually, not in CI, because the shared smoke admin signs in without MFA.

exitGates.gate: Master data changes are effective-dated and protected by permission.
notes: Organisation units, programme versions, curricula, academic periods, reference values, grading schemes, and GPA rule sets are effective-dated, audited with before/after snapshots, and need `master_data.publish`.
Maker-checker: the drafter cannot publish programme versions, grading schemes, or GPA rule sets.
Seeded grading bands and GPA rules are placeholders pending Academic Board approval.

exitGates.gate: Workflows, documents, and notifications are reusable by business modules.
notes: Workflows are versioned definitions with guarded transitions, decision authority, and terminal states.
Documents go through signed upload, size, checksum, and file-signature checks, scan, review, and audited signed download.
Malware scanning is recorded through an API; no scanner engine is integrated yet. Notifications queue but are not delivered (ADR-005).

exitGates.gate: Environments and schema can be recreated from version-controlled automation.
notes: `npm run test:integration` builds a throwaway database from migrations, seeds it, and runs every smoke script.
CI workflow exists (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) but has not run on a hosted runner because this workspace is not yet a git repository.
Staging and production environments do not exist yet (ADR-007 hosting is open).

exitGates.gate: Backup restoration and deployment rollback have been demonstrated.
notes: `npm run backup:rehearse` dumps, restores into a separate database, and verifies foundation counts.
exitGates.partial: Backup restore is rehearsed; deployment rollback cannot be shown until a deployment target exists (ADR-007).

openDecisions.recommendation: Modular monolith with clear internal modules
Build foundation-compatible identity now; allow future external IdP integration
Private object/file storage with DB metadata and short-lived access URLs
Provider-agnostic email/SMS adapters, in-app inbox first
Dependency-free Node scaffold for Phase 1 prototype; final production stack still requires approval
Confirm on-prem, cloud, or hybrid constraints
Keep Phase 1 foundation neutral; decide before Stage 6
Keep Phase 1 finance-neutral; decide before Stage 4
Legacy archive remains non-deployable read-only reference
Define retention by legal and institutional policy
Restrict disability, medical, and protected data with field-level policy
